specialists.market_data: All 10 verified group entries were WAIT, across four entry baskets. The five attempts spanning the group filled 4/2/3/0/4 legs, including three fills assigned to the next review. The 28-day testnet study found four simultaneous READY coins on 139/7,964 valid closes, 107 groups on 26 days before margin and execution checks. For prospective testing log missing candles and quotes, feasible baskets and complete/partial fills separately.
specialists.entry_exit: All 10 positions used the 10-minute clock and had a WAIT entry signal. Zero READY fills means the cohort cannot estimate the candidate's win rate or effect. Preserve time exit and existing protective brackets in the candidate. Final modeled comparisons: at 15m, 6 matched and 4 unavailable, actual wins 2/6 to modeled 1/6, mean change −$0.06840228. At 30m, 4 matched and 6 unavailable, actual wins 1/4 to modeled 0/4, mean change −$0.21088621. Unavailable cases include unverified incremental funding, insufficient traded volume, or ambiguous candle evidence. The matched subsets are small.
specialists.risk_costs: Gross loss $0.72300000, commission $1.01778535, funding $0, net loss $1.74078535. Four gross-positive trades shrank to two net winners. Maximum planned risk was $3.2001548 per trade. Planned batch loss and same-day loss stayed within the $30 cap. Evaluate spread/slippage plus commission since cost alone does not explain negative gross performance.
specialists.execution: Each of the 10 verified lots filled and closed exactly three contracts. Entry fills stayed within their IOC caps. Both protective orders were confirmed at entry. Each lot had a single acknowledged timed close. Submission lag ranged from 1.41 to 4.68 seconds after deadline and fill lag reached 4.83 seconds; execution logs show incomplete batches when quotes moved.
specialists.reconciliation_validation: Twenty distinct fills matched 20 wallet commission postings and 10 realized cashflows. There were 10 unique owned entry orders, with fully reconciled three-contract close on each. The group spans four correlated baskets on one IST day. It supports inspecting fees and waiting entries, with entry improvements subject to later independent validation.

manager.findings: First 10 net −$1.74078535 (2 winners, 8 losers, mean −$0.174078535). Worst loss −$0.75727935, max drawdown $1.78448474. Net without the largest win is −$1.79270856. Historical pilot candidate win rate 36.84% versus 17.69%, but both arms lost net and the per-trade candidate advantage reversed under extra execution costs. First review and exploratory history give a hypothesis, with independent confirmation still needed. Final paired exit results show a lower modeled mean at both 15 and 30 minutes, supporting retaining the current cap for further testing.
manager.recommendation: Run an independently logged matched-account candidate with four closed-bar READY coins while preserving the 10-minute exit, the sizing and all limits. Assess after-cost win rate, net expectancy and trade frequency, including idle dates. Preserve the existing strategy until evidence qualifies a change.

ceo.rationale: One correlated, net-losing review cannot qualify an entry change. The historical pilot suggests a plausible direction with cost sensitivity and reduced opportunity. Register the specific filter and independent protocol. Keep the 10-minute clock. A promotion requires passing the frozen criteria.

candidate.hypothesis: Require four simultaneous five-minute closed-bar READY breakouts on the approved five-coin universe. Select four qualifying feasible coins by existing turnover ranking. With three contracts per leg and unchanged exits and risk, after-cost win probability and mean net USD per verified-size lot should improve over WAIT-allowed baseline.
candidate.validation_protocol: Prospective fixed 84 complete IST days from the next full day after registration. Use matched quote and trade observations for both arms and separate portfolio states. Change only entry eligibility. Require all five valid 21-bar windows and at least four READY closes, defined as close above prior 20 highs with positive historical volume. No extra relative-volume threshold. Apply identical IOC boundaries, top-of-book/depth freshness and costs, first-fill 10-minute deadline, stop/target, sizing of three contracts, $10 per-position planned loss, $30 daily loss with reserved risk, max 5× and 80% margin. Record preflight passes, partial fills, missing quotes, inactive days and outcomes. Before promotion require candidate mean net above zero and positive one-sided 95% lower bounds on win-rate and mean net-USD improvements, paired resampling complete seven-day blocks retaining same-basket correlation, no worse drawdown, risk compliance, positive daily net and stable findings at doubled modeled spread/slippage. If evidence is incomplete report inconclusive. The CEO then reviews before any deployment.

delta-demo-trade1-four-ready-v1.validation_protocol: Prospective fixed 84 complete IST days from the next full day after registration. Use matched quote and trade observations for both arms and separate portfolio states. Change only entry eligibility. Require all five valid 21-bar windows and at least four READY closes, defined as close above prior 20 highs with positive historical volume. No extra relative-volume threshold. Apply identical IOC boundaries, top-of-book/depth freshness and costs, first-fill 10-minute deadline, stop/target, sizing of three contracts, $10 per-position planned loss, $30 daily loss with reserved risk, max 5× and 80% margin. Record preflight passes, partial fills, missing quotes, inactive days and outcomes. Before promotion require candidate mean net above zero and positive one-sided 95% lower bounds on win-rate and mean net-USD improvements, paired resampling complete seven-day blocks retaining same-basket correlation, no worse drawdown, risk compliance, positive daily net and stable findings at doubled modeled spread/slippage. If evidence is incomplete report inconclusive. The CEO then reviews before any deployment.
